reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that records model token usage, calculates costs, persists call data, and presents per-call, session, and global usage statistics with configurable pricing.

summaries.zh: 记录 DeepSeek Harness 的模型调用用量并按价格表计算费用，提供持久化明细、会话汇总和可视化使用统计页面。
summaries.en: Tracks DeepSeek Harness model usage, calculates costs from configurable price tables, and provides persisted details, session summaries, and a visual usage dashboard.

capabilities: Listens for completed model-call events and reads reported token usage
Calculates per-call and session costs from configurable price tables
Persists call records as JSONL files
Provides usage summaries, charts, filters, logs, and price configuration in a web UI
Exposes local HTTP routes for the usage data bridge
